line.name: Saint Luis Rey Carenas Ultramar
line.description: A distinct sub-line/blend from standard Carenas (not just a vitola name) - confirmed via separate Altadis product pages with different wrapper/binder specs. Tribute to 16th-century Spanish trade vessels that sailed 'ultramar' (overseas) from Puerto Carenas carrying tobacco.
line.factory: Flor de Copan, Santa Rosa de Copan, Honduras

research_notes: Ultramar's wrapper (Nicaraguan Habano) and binder (Nicaraguan) differ from standard Carenas (Nicaraguan wrapper, Honduran binder), confirming it's a separate blend rather than a vitola-only variant.
